name: vllm_awq_marlin_moe_repack
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_awq_marlin_moe_repack.py. AWQ-Marlin MoE weight repack: b_q_weight (num_experts,K,N//pack_factor) int32, perm (num_experts,K) int32 identity, size_k/n/num_bits scalars. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.awq_marlin_moe_repack and returns the repacked tensor. Shapes interdependent (pack_factor=32//num_bits) → gen_inputs. Workloads use num_bits=4. Requires vLLM at eval time.
